answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31756 Country: India Title: I want to go to US for higher studies but I cannot meet the expenses by my personal funds so need to take an education loan. Question: I want to go to US for higher studies but I cannot meet the expenses by my personal funds so need to take an education loan. Can I take a loan from bank ? If not how can I manage my expenses ? Answer ID: 31756 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 857/857/M=1432) In case of taking loan from bank, one has to give interest and hadith curses on interest based dealing; hence, one should avoid it. You should adopt any lawful source to bear your educational expenses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
